title: Specmetry check run result v1
description: Output of `specmetry check run --json`. With --json, stdout carries exactly one JSON document conforming to this schema and nothing else; the checks' own stdout and stderr are streamed to the caller's stderr. Without --json, check output is passed through to stdout/stderr unchanged. In both modes check output is never persisted. Exit code 10 when any run is not pass; exit code 6 with --isolation required when isolation cannot be established (no run is recorded).

is_target_snapshot.description: True when the worktree HEAD equals the delivery target snapshot at start; only then can observed qualifying runs affect delivery status.

isolation.description: Requested isolation mode. The MVP supports off and required (required always fails with exit 6 until the isolated executor ships); auto is reserved for the isolated executor.

isolation_fallback_reason.description: Only with isolation auto: why isolation could not be established before the run, so it ran as observed in the caller's worktree. A change detected in the private snapshot after the run is not a fallback: that run is recorded as error/context_changed and is not qualifying.
